title: market.bar.closed.v1
description: SKELETON, not yet wired into any service (docs/adr/007-shared-cross-service-contracts.md). ctrader-engine publishes this event once a candle closes; analysis-engine consumes it to advance internal/marketdata's rolling history. Fields mirror analysis-engine's internal/market.Candle (Time/Open/High/Low/Close/Volume) plus the Symbol/Timeframe identity every cross-service event needs. Today's live equivalent is the bars:{SYMBOL}:{TF} Redis ZSET entry shape (app/analysis/ohlc_source.py) — this schema is the target Kafka event, not yet adopted.

symbol.description: Canonical instrument identifier, e.g. "XAU" — matches market.Symbol / config's instruments.<symbol> key.

timeframe.description: Matches market.Timeframe exactly — do not add a value here that Timeframe.go's minutesByTimeframe map doesn't also have.

time.description: Unix second timestamp of the bar's close, matching market.Candle.Time's unit exactly (not milliseconds).
